gloss: secretary (to a high-ranking official); executive secretary

definitions.gloss: secretary (to a high-ranking official); executive secretary
definitions.explanation: A government-appointed secretary who assists a high-ranking official such as the prime minister, a cabinet minister, or an ambassador.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧{秘書官|ひしょかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}{会見|かいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The prime minister's secretary held a press conference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{秘書官|ひしょかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was appointed as secretary to the minister.

examples.japanese: {秘書官|ひしょかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The executive secretary handles a wide range of duties, from scheduling for the president to policy coordination.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{秘書|ひしょ}→秘書：05502_hisho⟧ (secretary) + {官|かん} (official; government position). Specifically refers to a government-appointed role, not a corporate secretary. The {官|かん} suffix marks it as an official governmental position. Frequently appears in political news and government reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧{秘書官|ひしょかん}: prime minister's secretary
- ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧{秘書官|ひしょかん}: minister's secretary
- {政務|せいむ}{秘書官|ひしょかん}: political secretary (appointed from the Diet)
- ⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧{秘書官|ひしょかん}: administrative secretary (career bureaucrat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{秘書|ひしょ}→秘書：05502_hisho⟧: secretary — the general term for any secretary, including corporate ones
- ⟦{官房長官|かんぼうちょうかん}→官房長官：28164_kanbouchoukan⟧: Chief Cabinet Secretary — a much higher-ranking position; effectively the government spokesperson
- ⟦{補佐官|ほさかん}→補佐官：24977_hosakan⟧: advisor; aide — an advisor to a top official, with more of a policy advisory role
